content.short: Non-custodial crypto payments that let customers pay with any token on any chain.
content.description: With CoinVoyage, a merchant's customer can pay in whatever token and chain they hold, and the funds arrive directly in the merchant's wallet or bank account in the asset the merchant chose. It covers invoicing, payment requests and an embeddable checkout widget, handling routing and conversion in the background. Travel companies are one of its main use cases, for flights, hotels and packages.
content.meta: Accept crypto in any token on any chain with CoinVoyage invoices and checkout, settled to your wallet or bank account.
